automation_trigger_schedule_fields_check.name: automation_trigger_schedule_fields_check
automation_trigger_schedule_fields_check.value: ("automation_trigger"."kind" <> 'schedule') or ("automation_trigger"."cron_expression" is not null and "automation_trigger"."timezone" is not null)

mail_conversation_assignment_active_memb.name: mail_conversation_assignment_active_member_unique
mail_conversation_assignment_active_memb.where: "mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_member_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_at" is null

mail_conversation_assignment_active_agen.name: mail_conversation_assignment_active_agent_unique
mail_conversation_assignment_active_agen.where: "mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_agent_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_at" is null

mail_conversation_assignment_assignee_ch.name: mail_conversation_assignment_assignee_check
mail_conversation_assignment_assignee_ch.value: ("mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_type" = 'member' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_member_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_agent_id" is null) or ("mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_type" = 'agent' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_agent_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assignee_member_id" is null)

mail_conversation_assignment_assigned_by.name: mail_conversation_assignment_assigned_by_check
mail_conversation_assignment_assigned_by.value: ("mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_type" = 'member' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_member_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_agent_id" is null) or ("mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_type" = 'agent' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_agent_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_member_id" is null) or ("mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_type" = 'system' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_member_id" is null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."assigned_by_agent_id" is null)

mail_conversation_assignment_unassigned_.name: mail_conversation_assignment_unassigned_check
mail_conversation_assignment_unassigned_.value: ("mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_at" is null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_type" is null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_member_id" is null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_agent_id" is null) or ("mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_at" is not null and (("mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_type" = 'member' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_member_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_agent_id" is null) or ("mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_type" = 'agent' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_agent_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_member_id" is null) or ("mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_type" = 'system' and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_member_id" is null and "mail_conversation_assignment"."unassigned_by_agent_id" is null)))

mail_conversation_state_actor_check.name: mail_conversation_state_actor_check
mail_conversation_state_actor_check.value: ("mail_conversation_state"."actor_type" = 'member' and "mail_conversation_state"."member_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_state"."agent_id" is null) or ("mail_conversation_state"."actor_type" = 'agent' and "mail_conversation_state"."agent_id" is not null and "mail_conversation_state"."member_id" is null)

mail_delivery_attempt_failure_check.name: mail_delivery_attempt_failure_check
mail_delivery_attempt_failure_check.value: "mail_delivery_attempt"."status" in ('bounced', 'failed') or ("mail_delivery_attempt"."failure_code" is null and "mail_delivery_attempt"."failure_message" is null)

mail_draft_sender_check.name: mail_draft_sender_check
mail_draft_sender_check.value: ("mail_draft"."from_address_id" is not null)::int + ("mail_draft"."from_sync_account_id" is not null)::int = 1

mail_draft_author_check.name: mail_draft_author_check
mail_draft_author_check.value: ("mail_draft"."author_type" = 'member' and "mail_draft"."author_member_id" is not null and "mail_draft"."author_agent_id" is null) or ("mail_draft"."author_type" = 'agent' and "mail_draft"."author_agent_id" is not null and "mail_draft"."author_member_id" is null)

mail_draft_reply_conversation_check.name: mail_draft_reply_conversation_check
mail_draft_reply_conversation_check.value: "mail_draft"."reply_to_message_id" is null or "mail_draft"."conversation_id" is not null

mail_draft_sent_conversation_check.name: mail_draft_sent_conversation_check
mail_draft_sent_conversation_check.value: "mail_draft"."sent_message_id" is null or "mail_draft"."conversation_id" is not null

mail_draft_activity_actor_check.name: mail_draft_activity_actor_check
mail_draft_activity_actor_check.value: ("mail_draft_activity"."actor_type" = 'member' and "mail_draft_activity"."member_id" is not null and "mail_draft_activity"."agent_id" is null) or ("mail_draft_activity"."actor_type" = 'agent' and "mail_draft_activity"."agent_id" is not null and "mail_draft_activity"."member_id" is null) or ("mail_draft_activity"."actor_type" = 'system' and "mail_draft_activity"."member_id" is null and "mail_draft_activity"."agent_id" is null)

mail_mailbox_access_actor_check.name: mail_mailbox_access_actor_check
mail_mailbox_access_actor_check.value: ("mail_mailbox_access"."actor_type" = 'member' and "mail_mailbox_access"."member_id" is not null and "mail_mailbox_access"."agent_id" is null) or ("mail_mailbox_access"."actor_type" = 'agent' and "mail_mailbox_access"."agent_id" is not null and "mail_mailbox_access"."member_id" is null)

mail_message_author_check.name: mail_message_author_check
mail_message_author_check.value: ("mail_message"."author_type" = 'member' and "mail_message"."author_member_id" is not null and "mail_message"."author_agent_id" is null) or ("mail_message"."author_type" = 'agent' and "mail_message"."author_agent_id" is not null and "mail_message"."author_member_id" is null) or ("mail_message"."author_type" in ('external', 'system') and "mail_message"."author_member_id" is null and "mail_message"."author_agent_id" is null)

mail_message_ingress_source_check.name: mail_message_ingress_source_check
mail_message_ingress_source_check.value: "mail_message"."source" = 'outbound' or ("mail_message"."ingress_provider" is not null and "mail_message"."ingress_provider_message_id" is not null)

mail_message_outbound_sender_check.name: mail_message_outbound_sender_check
mail_message_outbound_sender_check.value: "mail_message"."source" <> 'outbound' or (("mail_message"."sender_address_id" is not null)::int + ("mail_message"."sender_sync_account_id" is not null)::int = 1)

mail_sync_item_claim_check.name: mail_sync_item_claim_check
mail_sync_item_claim_check.value: ("mail_sync_item"."status" = 'pending' and "mail_sync_item"."claim_key" is null) or ("mail_sync_item"."status" <> 'pending' and "mail_sync_item"."claim_key" is not null)

mail_sync_item_result_check.name: mail_sync_item_result_check
mail_sync_item_result_check.value: ("mail_sync_item"."status" in ('imported', 'duplicate') and "mail_sync_item"."message_id" is not null and "mail_sync_item"."error" is null) or ("mail_sync_item"."status" = 'failed' and "mail_sync_item"."error" is not null) or ("mail_sync_item"."status" in ('pending', 'processing') and "mail_sync_item"."message_id" is null and "mail_sync_item"."error" is null)
